name: rdm_tag
label: R&D Management Tag Table
description: R&D management tag table, belonging to the R&D management module, used for querying, filtering, and reporting of related data in R&D management.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unique identifier. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_tag
indexes.description: Unique index covering the name field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
